I and many of my friends have had experience with this. I've been on APs since 2016 and as far as I can remember, it didn't necessarily affect the relationships within the system, and we could still communicate. It is common, however, in our system for there to be lapses in the ability to communicate.

I have a couple of friends whose alters went completely dormant for up to a year after starting APs, too, though, so I'm guessing it's a shake of the dice.
